name: suggest_topics
description: Return 3-5 fresh, blog-worthy topic candidates grounded in real web search results, each shaped like a manually-authored topic brief.

title_hint.description: A working title for the post

description.description: 1-3 sentence description of the post's angle and content

tone.description: Tone to write in, matching the blog's sarcastic, informational voice

outline.description: Required sections or points the post should cover

source_note.description: One sentence citing what was found via web search that grounds this topic in something real and recent
